description: Land Acquisition - Walgama, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific lots of land being acquired by the government for a public purpose. It contains descriptions of properties, their locations, extents, and claimant information, which squarely fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4) dealing with land acquisitions and property matters.
